text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy wasn't feeling well,
so I took her to the nurse's office...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making you worry...
I'm sure I'll get better soon...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With those words, Zenno Rob Roy got into bed and gently closed her eyes—

text_block_list.name: Townsperson
text_block_list.text: ...Roy! Zenno Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson
text_block_list.text:
The battle is about to begin!
All preparations are complete. Anytime...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Let's get going, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Huh?! My mouth is moving on its own...!
What am I saying...?!))

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: No matter how formidable the foe, if we unite as a single spear, we will surely pierce through.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Let us fight, and seize it with our own hands!
Our tomorrow, our future!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Whoa, somehow... somehow!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Now, here we go!

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text: Ooooooooh--!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I... I feel like I just had the most outrageous dream...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“I might've looked just a tiny bit cool back there, though...
...Ehehe...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Zenno Rob Roy returned afterward,
she had completely regained her groove!

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Townsfolk
text_block_list.text:
“—Hm, wait.
You... are an imposter!”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Townsfolk
text_block_list.text:
No matter how skillfully you try to deceive us with your words, I won't be fooled!
I see no hero in your heart! Capture them!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: U-Uwaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like... I just had
such a sad dream... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy returned from the infirmary,
looking somewhat melancholy...
